run_transitive_closure: run the script to compute the transitive closure of all WordNet noun hypernyms and instance relations
build_noun_closure_csv: build a CSV file containing all noun hypernym edges from the WordNet transitive closure
filter_mammal_relations: filter the noun closure dataset to extract only mammal-related hypernym relations
extract_mammal_set: extract the set of all WordNet nouns that have mammal.n.01 as a hypernym
export_mammal_closure_csv: export the filtered mammal hypernym relations to a CSV file after applying exclusion patterns
